name: @mjakl/pi-subagent
description: Subagent extension for Pi coding agent. Delegate tasks to specialized agents. Local editable fork.

scripts.acceptance:dry-run: bun run test/acceptance/live-harness.ts tmux --dry-run && bun run test/acceptance/live-harness.ts cmux --dry-run && bun run test/acceptance/live-harness.ts package --dry-run && bun run acceptance:cmux-layout-phase0:dry-run && bun run title:live:dry-run && bun run benchmark:phase0:preflight && bun run benchmark:phase0:verify && bun run benchmark:phase0:live:preflight && bun run benchmark:phase0:live:routine:verify && bun run benchmark:phase0:live:concurrency:verify && bun run benchmark:phase7:preflight && bun run benchmark:phase7:verify
scripts.acceptance:layout:dry-run: bun run test/acceptance/live-harness.ts tmux --dry-run && bun run test/acceptance/live-harness.ts cmux --dry-run
scripts.acceptance:layout: bun run test/acceptance/live-harness.ts tmux && bun run test/acceptance/live-harness.ts cmux
scripts.cmux:control-probe:dry-run: bun -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({ mode: "cmux-control-probe", dryRun: true, mutation: "none", requiredGate: "PI_SUBAGENT_CMUX_CONTROL_PROBE=1", state: "not-run" }))'
scripts.title:live:dry-run: bun run test/acceptance/live-title-smoke.ts tmux --dry-run && bun run test/acceptance/live-title-smoke.ts cmux --dry-run
scripts.benchmark:phase0:live:routine:verify: bun -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import { LIVE_ROUTINE_EVIDENCE_FIXTURE, verifyCurrentLiveEvidence } from "./test/acceptance/performance-phase0-live.ts"; const value=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(LIVE_ROUTINE_EVIDENCE_FIXTURE,"utf8")); if (!verifyCurrentLiveEvidence(value,"routine-v1")) throw new Error("routine live evidence schema, tier, or source binding is invalid"); console.log(JSON.stringify({tier:value.tier,cells:value.matrix.length,childRuns:value.requested.childRuns}));'
scripts.benchmark:phase0:live:concurrency:verify: bun -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import { LIVE_CONCURRENCY_EVIDENCE_FIXTURE, verifyCurrentLiveEvidence } from "./test/acceptance/performance-phase0-live.ts"; const value=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(LIVE_CONCURRENCY_EVIDENCE_FIXTURE,"utf8")); if (!verifyCurrentLiveEvidence(value,"cmux-concurrency-16-v1")) throw new Error("concurrency live evidence schema, tier, or source binding is invalid"); console.log(JSON.stringify({tier:value.tier,cells:value.matrix.length,childRuns:value.requested.childRuns}));'
scripts.benchmark:phase0:live:concurrency:valida: bun -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import { LIVE_CONCURRENCY_EVIDENCE_FIXTURE, validateLiveEvidence } from "./test/acceptance/performance-phase0-live.ts"; const value=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(LIVE_CONCURRENCY_EVIDENCE_FIXTURE,"utf8")); if (!validateLiveEvidence(value) || value.tier !== "cmux-concurrency-16-v1") throw new Error("concurrency live evidence schema or tier is invalid"); console.log(JSON.stringify({tier:value.tier,cells:value.matrix.length,childRuns:value.requested.childRuns,sourceBinding:"not-required"}));'
scripts.benchmark:phase0:live:verify: bun run benchmark:phase0:live:routine:verify && bun run benchmark:phase0:live:concurrency:verify
